scientific_question.narrow_question: Are the two datasets merely using the same anatomical DOF names, or are they also numerically calibrated to the same physical coordinate system?
scientific_question.explicitly_not_the_question: 'Were all 16 dimensions mapped to the wrong joints?'  The anatomical mapping has already been audited repeatedly and this branch does not restart from that naive hypothesis.
scientific_question.why_it_matters: The distributional open-set branch (db9_distributional_open_set) found ~80.6% of natural emg2pose GT poses outside all six DB9 gesture regions, all ten human-consensus target windows rejected, and a 179.7-degree-norm canonical16 grand-mean offset concentrated on middle_dip_flexion (-103 deg), ring_dip_flexion (-102 deg) and pinky_mcp_flexion (+79 deg).  Before that is called domain shift, numerical-coordinate mismatch must be excluded.

criteria.A_anatomical_dof: the same physical degree of freedom
criteria.B_joint_indexing: the same joint identified in both raw layouts
criteria.D_positive_direction: the same physical direction is positive
criteria.E_zero_definition: the same physical configuration is called zero
criteria.F_reference_pose: the same neutral/reference posture underlies that zero
criteria.G_angle_convention: the same mathematical angle convention (joint rotation vs derived interior angle; flexion-from-straight vs joint angle)
criteria.H_range_wrapping: the same range and wrapping convention
criteria.J_preprocessing_calibration: the same calibration semantics (what the number is measured against)

hypotheses.H0_TRUE_NUMERICAL_EQUIVALENCE: After the already-frozen thumb CMC-AA sign correction, canonical dimensions are genuinely in the same physical coordinate system.  Large distribution differences therefore reflect real dataset / domain / behaviour differences rather than a mapping or calibration error.
hypotheses.H1_CONSTANT_ZERO_OFFSET: Same physical angle and direction, but a different neutral/reference zero: theta_B ~ theta_A + b.
hypotheses.H2_AFFINE_COORDINATE_MISMATCH: Same physical DOF, different numerical coordinate: theta_B ~ a*theta_A + b.
hypotheses.H3_ANGLE_CONVENTION_MISMATCH: At least one dimension uses a fundamentally different angular parameterization: -theta, pi-theta, theta-pi, |theta|, wrapped theta, interior angle vs flexion-from-straight, complementary convention.
hypotheses.H4_MIXED_PER_JOINT_CONVENTIONS: A subset of dimensions is genuinely aligned while another subset is not.
hypotheses.H5_REAL_DISTRIBUTION_SHIFT: Coordinate definitions agree, but the two datasets occupy different parts of the same pose space because of task / behaviour / sampling differences.
hypotheses.H6_BOTH: Representation mismatch AND substantial genuine distribution shift.

db9_raw.contents: MATLAB v5 .mat with variables angles (N,22) float64 in degrees, glove (N,22) raw CyberGlove-II sensor values, stimulus, restimulus, repetition, rerepetition, order_of_angles, subject, exercise, glove
db9_raw.role: the only place the raw un-calibrated sensor values and the per-recording movement stream coexist, so the per-channel linear calibration can be recovered and the reference posture can be located

db9_canonical16.role: the 7854 subject x movement x repetition representative postures actually used by DB9 modelling, plus the raw-file fingerprint needed for parity reconstruction

db9_trajectories.role: per-repetition continuous trajectories, for within-repetition shape checks

emg2pose_raw.role: official 20D joint_angles (T,20) radians, EMG, attrs including stage / side / session; the source of every emg2pose canonical16 number

emg2pose_paired.role: the frozen GT canonical16 and VEMG2Pose-predicted canonical16 on the frozen 50 Hz grid; the ONLY emg2pose pose source the distributional branch used

human_consensus.role: matched-semantic comparison: human-consensus CLASS_1 / CLASS_6 windows under the frozen ontology
human_consensus.usage_policy: READ-ONLY and DESCRIPTIVE.  These labels are a two-rater consensus under a frozen ontology, NOT ground truth.  They may NOT be used to fit, select or tune any transform.  Any candidate transform is estimated from source-only evidence; the human labels can only OBSERVE the consequence.

frozen_docs_and_code.role: source-of-truth definitions and every code path that builds canonical16

s4_geometry.role: independent consistency cross-check: forward-kinematics interior angles vs the stored canonical16 joint angles

source_only_estimators.robust_core_match: Match the robust core of the two marginal distributions: b = median(EMG2POSE_j) - median(DB9_j) for T6; for T7, b and a are the offset and scale that map DB9's [q05, q95] onto EMG2POSE's [q05, q95].  Uses no human label and no model outcome.
source_only_estimators.source_pairing_regression: Estimate from SOURCE-SIDE evidence only: the per-channel DB9 linear calibration recovered from the raw .mat (angle = a_sensor * glove + b_sensor), inspected against the raw sensor's own reference value.  This is a DB9-internal quantity and touches no emg2pose data.

transform_applicability_rule: T2-T5 are evaluated for every dimension but are only INTERPRETED where the dimension's observed range is smaller than a full turn (|range| < 2*pi) AND its official joint limits are a bounded interval.  A transform that 'improves' a full-turn channel is meaningless and is reported as such.

counts_as_convention_or_coordinate_misma: an official definition states a different zero, sign, unit or angle convention for one dataset than the other, AND the data are consistent with it

the raw DB9 per-channel linear calibration implies a reference sensor value that is unreachable (outside the observed sensor range) for that channel, i.e. the calibration's own zero is not attained during the recording

a non-identity transform maps the two marginal supports onto each other with a large, joint-specific, MONOTONE effect that is stable across subjects AND across movements AND across sessions, while the identity transform does not

a dimension's DB9 values are physically impossible while the same DOF's emg2pose values are physically plausible over the same physical action, and the DB9 raw sensor channel is not itself pathological
matched-semantic samples (same human-consensus gesture) preserve a large offset that a whole-dataset composition explanation cannot produce
counts_as_real_distribution_shift_only: the marginals overlap substantially at physically comparable anchors
the difference is explained by which behaviours were sampled (task/vocabulary composition), demonstrated by matching on movement class rather than by comparing grand means
the difference is stable between DB9 source databases, which cannot be a cross-dataset mapping effect
the per-subject spread inside a dataset is comparable to or larger than the between-dataset difference
matched-semantic samples agree in location within their own noise
explicitly_not_evidence: a large GRAND-MEAN difference by itself
a Wasserstein or MMD reduction by itself
a p-value computed over tens of thousands of correlated frames
evidence_rules.grand_mean_rule: A grand-mean difference MUST be decomposed before it is interpreted: (1) task/vocabulary composition, (2) subject differences, (3) session differences, (4) within-gesture differences, and only then (5) any residual coordinate/calibration difference.  The phrase 'a 100 degree mean shift proves a zero mismatch' may not appear in any output of this branch.

per_joint_reporting_slices.E_by_handedness: emg2pose left / right (DB9 has no side field: right-hand protocol only, documented)
per_joint_reporting_slices.G_by_stage_emg2pose: per stage name, for composition accounting only

variance_decomposition.model: classical two-way random-effects style decomposition computed by sums of squares on per-(unit, dimension) medians; no deep learning, no model fitting
variance_decomposition.estimator: ANOVA-style variance components from group means and counts
variance_decomposition.caveat: DB9 movement ids and emg2pose stage names are NOT a shared vocabulary; the decomposition is therefore computed within each dataset and only the SUBJECT-level components are compared across datasets.

db9_documented_reference_posture.definition: the official DB9 calibration reference: the central part of movement 11 in exercise B, hand resting on the table with fingers closed together and extended
db9_documented_reference_posture.how_located: by the frozen movement id, from the raw stimulus stream
db9_documented_reference_posture.expected: all 15 flexion channels near zero IF the released data honour the documented calibration

db9_least_flexed_and_most_flexed.definition: per-dimension empirical extremes over the six gestures
db9_least_flexed_and_most_flexed.how_located: argmin / argmax of the per-dimension median over repetitions

emg2pose_rest_pose.definition: the official 20D zero vector, whose FK pose is documented as an extended hand

emg2pose_stage_name_probe.definition: stage names that plausibly contain an extended or a flexed configuration, e.g. IndividualFingerPointingSnap or a fist-like stage
emg2pose_stage_name_probe.status: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY.  The project has already ruled that emg2pose stage names are not frame-level gesture labels; the 88 human windows are spread over all 30 sessions, so stage names may NOT be used as gesture truth.  They are used only to check that a per-stage median moves in the direction the stage name implies.

hard_stop: a frozen artifact this branch reads has changed hash
a parity check fails to machine tolerance where exactness is expected
two code paths construct canonical16 with different numbers
do_not_stop_for: a large grand-mean difference on its own
a negative result for the coordinate-equivalence hypothesis
a transform that does not help
stop_rules.completion_rule: The branch is complete when every canonical16 dimension has all ten criteria assessed, every prespecified transform has been evaluated, the large-offset joints, the DB9 source-database question and the matched-semantic question have all been answered, and the joint-by-joint verdict table is filled in.  A dimension may be left UNRESOLVED only with a stated reason and a stated minimum new evidence that would resolve it.
stop_rules.anti_rescue: This session is successful if the answer is 'the coordinates are genuinely equivalent and the shift is real', and successful if the answer is 'the anatomical mapping was correct but one or more numerical angle conventions were not equivalent'.  The only failure is leaving the ambiguity unresolved without exhausting the available evidence.

prohibitions.no_deployed_offset_transform: The branch may NOT emit 'subtract 103 degrees from emg2pose middle DIP'. It may diagnose a candidate convention relationship, verify a transform implied by official definitions, and demonstrate descriptively what a hypothetical transform would do.  Repair requires a NEW branch with a source-justified transform frozen before any external scoring.

decision_tree.COORD-A: numeric coordinates verified equivalent; large shifts are real dataset/task/domain differences
decision_tree.COORD-B: zero/offset calibration mismatch; same DOFs and directions, different zero/reference definitions
decision_tree.COORD-C: angle-convention mismatch; at least one important joint uses a fundamentally different angular parameterization
decision_tree.COORD-D: mixed coordinate mismatch; some dimensions equivalent, others not
decision_tree.COORD-E: both coordinate mismatch and real distribution shift
decision_tree.COORD-F: inconclusive; available source definitions/data cannot distinguish
decision_tree.rule: Exactly one primary outcome is assigned.  A stronger outcome is not forced than the evidence supports.  COORD-E requires BOTH a demonstrated coordinate difference AND a demonstrated residual difference after accounting for it.

statistical_rules.no_pseudo_replication: frames are never treated as independent participants; DB9 uncertainty is clustered at subject level, emg2pose at session level

predicted_reference_frames.note: Recorded from the frozen documentation BEFORE the numeric audit so that the audit tests a prediction rather than rationalising a result.
predicted_reference_frames.emg2pose_zero: the official 20D zero vector; FK at zero is a fingers-extended hand (inter-finger chain angles 168-179 deg, ~180 = straight)
predicted_reference_frames.emg2pose_thumb_aa: no global sign; per-finger polarity; the thumb's positive direction is opposite the four non-thumb MCP AA joints
predicted_reference_frames.db9_zero: sensor signals transformed relative to a reference posture: the central part of movement 11 in exercise B, hand resting on the table with fingers closed together and extended
predicted_reference_frames.db9_positive: flexion for the 15 FE channels; abduction for CMC1_A
predicted_reference_frames.frozen_bridge_transform: one column selection, degrees->radians, and exactly one sign flip on thumb_cmc_ab_adduction

pre_registration_statement: Every rule, transform, evidence criterion, metric and stop rule in this document was written before any new cross-dataset numerical outcome was computed.  Additions after this freeze are recorded as deviations in the report, and the frozen plan is never edited.
